name: Ghost
description: Drive Ghost (open-source publishing platform) from any AI agent: posts, pages, tags, members, newsletters. 12 tools, Admin API key auth.
instructions:
This connector uses the **Ghost Admin API v5** (https://ghost.org/docs/admin-api/) of one Ghost site, self-hosted or on Ghost(Pro).

**Setup**
1. In Ghost Admin open **Settings → Advanced → Integrations → Add custom integration** and give it a name (e.g. AnythingMCP).
2. `GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY`: copy the integration's **Admin API key**, `<id>:<secret>` (24 hex characters, a colon, 64 hex characters). The **Content API key** of the same page does not work here: it only reads published content.
3. `GHOST_ADMIN_API_URL`: the integration's **API URL** followed by `/ghost/api/admin`, e.g. `https://yoursite.ghost.io/ghost/api/admin` or `https://yoursite.com/ghost/api/admin`.

**How it signs in**: Ghost never accepts the Admin API key itself. For every request the connector signs a short-lived token (HS256 JWT, `kid` = the key id, `aud` = `/admin/`, valid 5 minutes) with the secret half of the key and sends it as `Authorization: Ghost <token>`. Nothing expires on your side: the key stays valid until you delete the integration in Ghost.

**Permissions**: a custom integration acts with Admin rights on the whole site, members and newsletters included. Writes (create, update, delete) act on the live site.

**Post status**: draft, published, scheduled, sent.

**Mobiledoc vs Lexical**: Ghost stores post content in either format. Modern Ghost (v5+) defaults to Lexical (`lexical` field). Set `html` on writes (with `source=html`) and Ghost converts it to its internal format.

**Updating a post**: Ghost requires the post's current `updated_at` in the update, to refuse edits based on a stale copy. Read the post first with ghost_get_post.

**Pagination**: `?page=N&limit=M` (max 100 for posts/pages, 15 for some). The response has `meta.pagination`.

**Out of scope here**: themes, settings, redirects, webhooks, oEmbed.
prerequisites: A Ghost site (Ghost 5 or later, self-hosted or Ghost(Pro)) and an Owner or Administrator account, to add a custom integration.

GHOST_ADMIN_API_URL.label: Admin API URL
GHOST_ADMIN_API_URL.help: Your site's address followed by /ghost/api/admin, e.g. https://yoursite.ghost.io/ghost/api/admin. The custom integration's page shows the API URL to start from.
GHOST_ADMIN_API_URL.patternMessage: Paste your site's address followed by /ghost/api/admin, e.g. https://yoursite.ghost.io/ghost/api/admin.

GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY.label: Admin API key
GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY.help: Ghost Admin → Settings → Advanced → Integrations → your custom integration → Admin API key: <id>:<secret>. Not the Content API key.
GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the Admin API key: 24 characters, a colon, 64 characters. The Content API key (no colon) does not work here.

verifyHints.401: Ghost refused the token. Check that GHOST_ADMIN_API_KEY is the Admin API key of a custom integration that still exists (not the Content API key).
verifyHints.403: Ghost refused the request: the integration has no access. Create a custom integration as an Owner or Administrator and use its Admin API key.
verifyHints.404: Ghost has no Admin API at this address. GHOST_ADMIN_API_URL must end with /ghost/api/admin, e.g. https://yoursite.ghost.io/ghost/api/admin.

tools.name: ghost_list_posts
tools.description: List posts. Each post has id, uuid, title, slug, html, status, published_at, authors, tags, featured.

tools.name: ghost_get_post
tools.description: Fetch a post by ID (or by slug with /slug/{slug}/).

tools.name: ghost_create_post
tools.description: Create a post. Pass html for content. Set status='published' to publish immediately, 'scheduled' + published_at for future, 'draft' for draft.

posts.description: Wrap your post in {posts:[{title, html, status?, slug?, custom_excerpt?, feature_image?, featured?, tags?:[{name}], authors?:[{email}], visibility?:'public'|'members'|'paid', published_at?, email_recipient_filter?:'all'|'none'|'paid'|...}]}. Ghost requires this wrapper array.

source.description: If 'html', the engine accepts html field in posts[].

tools.name: ghost_update_post
tools.description: Update a post. MUST include updated_at field matching the current value (Ghost's optimistic concurrency check) — fetch with ghost_get_post first.

posts.description: [{updated_at: <current>, title?, html?, status?, ...}]. updated_at is required.

tools.name: ghost_list_pages
tools.description: List static pages (separate from posts). Pages have similar shape to posts.

tools.name: ghost_list_members
tools.description: List members (subscribers, both free and paid).

search.description: Substring search across name and email.

tools.name: ghost_list_newsletters
tools.description: List newsletters on the site (Ghost supports multiple newsletters per site since v5).

tools.name: ghost_site
tools.description: Return site info (title, description, version, url). Health check.
